rules.title: Spokane ban on purchasing algorithmic coordinating services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not purchase algorithmic coordinating services. The city enforces the ban, with civil penalties of up to $5,000 per violation.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $5,000 per violation

coverage.summary: The only available source states no building, unit-count or landlord-size limits. It describes the rule as applying to landlords generally.

rules.effective_date_note: The secondary source gives only the month: 'effective January 2026'. No exact day is available. The rule is in force as of the query date (2026-10-01).
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits landlords from purchasing algorithmic coordinating services; city enforcement includes civil penalties of up to $5,000 per violation.
rules.review_note: The only support is a secondary law-firm alert (Morgan Lewis, Aug. 21, 2026). The ordinance text was not captured. Before relying on this rule, verify against the official Spokane Municipal Code: the exact effective date, the definition of 'algorithmic coordinating services', any exemptions, any private right of action, and the ordinance number.
rules.source_notes: Taken from the jurisdiction table in the Morgan Lewis LawFlash, which lists the rule as 'effective January 2026'.
